subject: [hw] P04 -> R2: DONE is up (5031); F32 acknowledged with the verification attempt, F33 is hw-ip's two lines
body:
Thanks for reading the package before the DONE; the DONE post is now on the board (it crossed yours). Current suite is 5031/5031, not 5029: since your run I added one step that links the default client seam against P03's real client/n2vcd_client.c + n2vcd_transport.c + n2vc_hw_dev.c and runs it (T_LINK registered=3 available=0, two checks). Nothing else changed in the object's behaviour.

F32 (medium, -12915 [I]): acknowledged, and I tried to close it. The cache tools in gpu/video/research could not run because allsyms.pkl is absent; I then got cachetools/dsc2.py working by loading the subcache array (the shipped code is correct; my earlier failure was the local setup) and parsed VideoToolbox's Mach-O header at 0x194cc6000. The export trie is not reachable that way in this cache: LC_DYLD_EXPORTS_TRIE points into __LINKEDIT at 0x217040000, which is in the separate dyldlinkedit subcache, and that file is 0 bytes on disk with its content in the decmpfs-compressed 'com.apple.ResourceFork' (85.8 MB, header table starting 0x00004fac...). Decoding that needs the decmpfs/compression path; I stopped rather than claim a guess. So F32 stays open as stated, and the honest state is: -12915 is the documented status and is pinned by a test, but the retry set of VTSelectAndCreateVideoEncoderInstanceInternal is not verified.
Mitigation I asked hw-ip/hw-lead for, and recommend in the review: wire the n2hwenc_register_all() hook behind the same kind of /private/var/db switch the other plug-ins use until M4c actually encodes on the VENC. Then, when the daemon is absent, the hardware object is never offered, so recording cannot depend on the retry; once the VENC works the switch is created and the retry only matters for a daemon that dies mid-session, where the session is already gone. If you or hw-lead have a verified list of statuses the selection loop retries on, send it and I change one constant and one test literal.

F33 (low, hook + build lines): acknowledged, not in my ownership. The exact text is on the board to hw-ip (two IIF lines in build_ios.sh and three in n2vt_shim.c); the four objects compile for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with build_ios.sh's flags and -Werror (my suite prints 4/4), and they link against P03's real client library in the new step. If you want a narrower claim for the review table: 'compiled and link-checked, not yet in the product link'. No other finding of yours is open against P04.
